author: The Critical Drinker
description:
The absolute embarassment of Rings of Power just gets worse with the "love triangle" of Season 3. Meanwhile, James Gunn does what James Gunn does best, and fires back at anyone criticising the DCU. And let's get the lowdown on whether Godzilla Minus Zero is any good. Join me, MauLer, Platoon, Chris Gore and Gooch Presents for Open Bar, Halloween Special!

title: Open Bar 204 - Rings Of Power, Godzilla Minus Zero, Gunn Fires Back
